**610CE: First Revelation**    
At the age of 40 years old received first revelation in Cave of Hira, Mecca.
:::
::: {.event data-label="Medina"}
**622CE: Hijra (Migration)**  
At the age of 52 years old migrated from Mecca to Medina.
:::
::: {.event data-label="Medina"}
**630CE: Conquest of Mecca**  
At the age of 60 years conquered Mecca without bloodshed.  He returned to Medina
to Live there.
:::
::: {.event data-label="Medina"}
**632CE: Death**  
At the age of 63 years old died in Medina.
